[SWS_DM_00086] Resetting the debounce counter after clearing DTC
⌈
If
the DM executes a ClearDTC command, the DM shall reset the debounce counter for
all events that have a DiagnosticEventToTroubleCodeUdsMapping to one of the
cleared DTCs.
⌋
